learning_outcomes.text: Prepare a consolidated statement of financial position including goodwill and non-controlling interest
Prepare a consolidated statement of profit or loss with non-controlling interest
Eliminate intra-group balances, trading and unrealised profit
Account for mid-year acquisitions and fair-value adjustments on consolidation
Account for associates using the equity method within group statements
Account for changes in ownership, including step acquisitions and disposals

integrative_case: A parent acquired a subsidiary part-way through the year with fair-value adjustments, trades with it and holds unrealised profit in inventory, has an intra-group loan, and also holds a significant-influence stake in an associate; prepare the consolidated statement of financial position and profit or loss with goodwill and non-controlling interest, perform the eliminations, equity-account the associate, and explain the effect of a later partial disposal.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
